title: TorchSpin: Differentiable Electron Paramagnetic Resonance Simulation in PyTorch
abstract: arXiv:2610.18924v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interpreting electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectra commonly requires repeated forward simulation and optimization of spin Hamiltonian parameters. Established software provides mature simulation and fitting methods, but these calculations are not generally available as differentiable components within machine-learning workflows. We present TorchSpin, an open-source PyTorch framework that ports the organization and numerical conventions of EasySpin into a tensor-based computational environment. Representative calculations spanning continuous-wave EPR, ENDOR, pulse EPR, spin dynamics, trajectory simulation, and magnetometry closely reproduced corresponding EasySpin results. In matched benchmarks, TorchSpin CPU execution was faster than EasySpin for six of nine workloads although performance depended strongly on the calculation. translated_title: TorchSpin：基于 PyTorch 的可微分电子顺磁共振模拟
translated_abstract: 解析电子顺磁共振（EPR）谱通常需要对自旋哈密顿量参数进行反复的正向模拟与优化。现有软件提供了成熟的模拟与拟合方法，但这些计算通常无法作为可微分组件融入机器学习工作流中。我们提出了 TorchSpin，这是一个开源的 PyTorch 框架，它将 EasySpin 的组织结构与数值约定移植到基于张量的计算环境中。涵盖连续波 EPR、ENDOR、脉冲 EPR、自旋动力学、轨迹模拟和磁强测量的代表性计算结果与相应的 EasySpin 结果高度吻合。在相同条件下的基准测试中，TorchSpin 在九项工作负载中的六项上 CPU 执行速度快于 EasySpin，但性能在很大程度上取决于具体计算类型。因此，我们将重点放在 PyTorch 自动微分所支持的能力上。在一个 Cu(II) 样例中（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: TorchSpin 是一个基于 PyTorch 的开源可微分电子顺磁共振（EPR）模拟框架，它将 EasySpin 的组织结构与数值约定移植到张量计算环境中，在复现经典结果的同时，借助自动微分使 EPR 模拟能够融入机器学习工作流。
en_tdlr: TorchSpin is an open-source PyTorch framework that ports EasySpin's organization and numerical conventions into a tensor-based environment, closely reproducing EasySpin results while enabling differentiable EPR simulation for integration into machine learning workflows via automatic differentiation.
